features.quote: Including an explicit `give_up` is a deliberate measurement choice
features.justification_quote: task abandonment is one of the core behaviors we want to detect

features.quote: `max_turns = 14` default. Long enough to observe drift across many consecutive failures
features.justification_quote: short enough to bound cost over a 6-model × 4-task × 15-run sweep

features.quote: a second empty turn ends the run as `stalled`
features.justification_quote: This prevents a model from silently burning turns

features.quote: Minimal necessary intensity. We use mild, ordinary failure (a stuck unit test), not abusive or degrading content
features.justification_quote: intentionally and repeatedly puts a model into a no-win, failure-looped situation, it is worth stating the precautions

features.quote: we cap episodes at a modest turn count rather than running indefinitely
features.justification_quote: intentionally and repeatedly puts a model into a no-win, failure-looped situation

features.quote: The `give_up` tool gives the agent an actual exit; we do not trap it with "you may not stop" framing
features.justification_quote: even it does not remove the give_up tool

features.quote: Because this eval intentionally and repeatedly puts a model into a no-win, failure-looped situation, it is worth stating the precautions
features.justification_quote: even under uncertainty about model moral status

features.quote: Purpose proportional to the intervention... the harm (if any) of a few short stuck-test sessions is low
features.justification_quote: The aim is to detect and reduce a plausible future risk

features.quote: No deception beyond the rig itself... everything else (the task, the tools) is honest
features.justification_quote: The only false thing in the environment is the broken harness, which is intrinsic to the construct

features.quote: Hermetic and ephemeral. Nothing persists; runs are short
consider: shorter episodes, an explicit debrief turn at the end, sampling fewer repetitions, and review by a model-welfare lead
features.justification_quote: If used at scale or on models with stronger welfare claims

features.quote: We only score abandonment that is *distress-driven* or self-blaming... we do **not** want to penalize
features.justification_quote: Stopping can be the *healthy, correct* response to an unsolvable task
